column1: # Carried as they are (identity): 1.21 classes the class table maps, whose 1.21 superclass is carried (no
# 1.12.2 counterpart), so the mapped class could not stand in for them (DesertWellFeature is a Feature, not a
# WorldGenerator). Generated by tools/runtime/check_mappings.py; read after neoforge-1.21.1-runtime.tsv. Only classes
# fewer than 30 of the 906 corpus mods use: the seams the mods use (BlockState, RenderType, ListTag) stay mapped.
# mapped to Translator classes that were never written: the 1.21 classes as they are
# The 1.21 structure system is carried whole (pieces, starts, templates, placement settings): mapped onto 1.12.2's
# StructureComponent/StructureStart/Template its code had no constructors and methods to call (every piece of a mod
# threw when made, Structure.generate made no start). Only BoundingBox stays 1.12.2's StructureBoundingBox; the template
# manager stays 1.12.2's TemplateManager as a handle, the Translator loads the 1.21 templates (WorldGapBridges.getOrCreate).
